scope.audit_semantics: Source identity, location, derivation, and observation audit only.

compile_database.build_environment_note: Host Python packages were isolated under /tmp/tafuzz_px4_v117_pydeps and supplied through PYTHONPATH; no source-tree dependency files were edited.

binding_translation_unit_coverage.note: commander_params.c and rtl_params.c are PX4 parameter metadata inputs rather than direct compiler translation units; all bound names from them were verified in build/px4_sitl_default/parameters.json.

audit_policy.wire_support_policy: STATIC_SUPPORTED and CONDITIONAL mean source support only; neither means a runtime frame was observed.
audit_policy.clock_policy: Vehicle boot timestamps are retained where present. Host arrival time is never substituted for vehicle receipt time.
audit_policy.macro_policy: Macro locations are null unless a binding is specifically to a macro invocation; no inferred expansion coordinate is fabricated.
